description: Space type for a laundryroom group's meetups. Uses the atproto spaces alpha lexicon syntax (type space).

main.description: A laundryroom group's meetups, with the group's DID as the authority. skey self holds the members' calendar; skey staff holds hidden meetups that only owners, admins and moderators may read. The group writes events, event info, attendance, pledge boards and items, labels and the access record; members write rsvps and pledge fulfillments into their own repos.
main.name: laundryroom group meetups
